scope: independent source and tier processes, four-disk erasure, actual scanner, OC protected lifecycle writes

checks: OC registers two independent ILM labels and distinct ARNs on the remote service
OC protects and saves complete mixed lifecycle XML, then reads the new canonical document and revision
real scanners select the due rule, transition noncurrent versions and empty objects, and preserve latest/filter-mismatched data
authenticated lifecycle capability gates target writes; CLI credential and metadata edits retain exact destinations and referenced objects
source restart, rule deletion and current-to-noncurrent changes retain exact remote versions, metadata and range reads
durable target references prevent removing both destinations after lifecycle deletion and restart
version-specific restore serves local data during tier outage; deletion intent retains its reference and resumes after restart without lifecycle rules
single and bulk permanent deletes remove exact tier versions before source references; drained targets can be removed
synthetic OC aliases remain unchanged and all owned fixture processes are stopped
